# sternberg and n-back

## load libs
```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library("kableExtra")
library("tidyverse")
```

## plot settings
```{r}
txt <- element_text(size = 17, family = "Avenir", color = "black")

theme_set(
  theme_classic() +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          text = txt,
          axis.text = txt)
)
```

## load raw data
```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
path.data <- file.path("~", "Documents", "Psych45", "mia1")

df.sternberg <- path.data %>% 
  list.files(pattern = ".*sternberg.*csv",
             full.names = TRUE) %>% 
  read_csv(show_col_types = FALSE) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(response_type)) %>% 
  select(subject_id,
         trial_index,
         match_type,
         response_type,
         correct,
         rt) %>% 
  unique() %>% 
  mutate(acc = as.numeric(correct),
         rt = as.numeric(rt),
         lnrt = log(rt))

df.nback <- path.data %>% 
  list.files(pattern = ".*nback.*csv",
             full.names = TRUE) %>% 
  read_csv(show_col_types = FALSE) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(response_type)) %>% 
  filter(!exclude_trial) %>% 
  select(subject_id, 
         trial_index,
         phase,
         match_type,
         response_type,
         correct,
         rt) %>% 
  unique() %>% 
  filter(response_type != "NO_RESPONSE") %>% 
  mutate(acc = as.numeric(correct),
         acc_labs = ifelse(correct, "correct", "incorrect"),
         rt = as.numeric(rt),
         lnrt = log(rt))
```

## sternberg results (*N =* `r df.sternberg %>% pull(subject_id) %>% unique %>% length`)

### accuracy
```{r fig.width=8, fig.height=8}
df.sternberg %>% 
  group_by(subject_id) %>% 
  summarise(mean_acc = mean(acc)) %>% 
  filter(mean_acc > 0) %>% 
  ggplot(mapping = aes(x = "Sternberg",
                       y = mean_acc)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2,
              height = 0,
              alpha = 0.3,
              size = 4) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = "mean_cl_boot",
               color = "blue",
               size = 1) +
  labs(title = "Sternberg Task - Psych 45 Students - Spring 2025",
       subtitle = paste0("(N = ", df.sternberg %>% group_by(subject_id) %>% summarise(mean_acc = mean(acc)) %>% filter(mean_acc > 0) %>% ungroup() %>% pull(subject_id) %>% unique %>% length, ")"),
       x = "",
       y = "Proportion correct")
```

## n-back results (*N =* `r df.nback %>% pull(subject_id) %>% unique %>% length`)

### accuracy
```{r fig.width=8, fig.height=8, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
df.nback %>% 
  group_by(subject_id, phase) %>% 
  summarise(mean_acc = mean(acc)) %>% 
  ggplot(mapping = aes(x = phase,
                       y = mean_acc,
                       color = phase,
                       fill = phase)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2,
              height = 0,
              alpha = 0.3,
              size = 4) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = "mean_cl_boot",
               color = "black",
               size = 1) +
  labs(title = "N-Back Task - Psych 45 Students - Spring 2025",
       subtitle = paste0("(N = ", df.nback %>% pull(subject_id) %>% unique %>% length, ")"),
       x = "",
       y = "Proportion correct") +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")
```

### reaction time
```{r fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
df.nback %>% 
  ggplot(mapping = aes(x = acc_labs,
                       y = rt,
                       color = phase)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2,
              height = 0,
              alpha = 0.1,
              size = 1) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = "mean_cl_boot",
               color = "black",
               size = 1) +
  labs(title = "N-Back Task - Psych 45 Students - Spring 2025",
       subtitle = paste0("(N = ", df.nback %>% pull(subject_id) %>% unique %>% length, ")"),
       x = "",
       y = "Reaction time (ms)") +
  facet_grid(rows = ~phase) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")
```

<!-- ## missing data checks (for completion-based credit) -->
```{r echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}
path.data %>% 
  list.files(pattern = ".*sternberg.*csv",
             full.names = TRUE) %>% 
  read_csv(show_col_types = FALSE) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(response_type)) %>% 
  group_by(subject_id) %>%
  summarise(nil_resps = sum(response_type == "NO_RESPONSE")) %>%
  mutate(prop_missing = nil_resps / 20) %>% 
  arrange(desc(nil_resps)) %>% 
  kable()

path.data %>% 
  list.files(pattern = ".*nback.*csv",
             full.names = TRUE) %>% 
  read_csv(show_col_types = FALSE) %>% 
  filter(!exclude_trial) %>% 
  filter(phase != "fixation") %>% 
  filter(!is.na(response_type)) %>% 
  group_by(subject_id, phase) %>%
  summarise(nil_resps = sum(response_type == "NO_RESPONSE")) %>%
  mutate(
    expected_num_resp_trials = case_when(
      phase == "1back" ~ 19,
      phase == "2back" ~ 18,
      phase == "3back" ~ 17,
      phase == "4back" ~ 16,
      TRUE ~ -1
    )
  ) %>% 
  mutate(prop_missing = nil_resps / expected_num_resp_trials) %>%
  group_by(subject_id) %>% 
  summarise(
    total_nil_resps = sum(nil_resps),
    avg_nil_resps = mean(prop_missing)
  ) %>% 
  arrange(desc(avg_nil_resps)) %>% 
  kable()
```
